# Bitcoin Mining Depot

> Hong Kong-based supplier of new, used and refurbished ASIC bitcoin mining hardware (Antminer, WhatsMiner, Avalon), shipped worldwide with bench-tested units, wholesale pricing, hosting and repair services.

Bitcoin Mining Depot sells and ships SHA-256 and Equihash ASIC miners direct from a Causeway Bay, Hong Kong warehouse to the USA, Canada, Europe, the UK, Australia and 100+ other countries. Every unit is bench-tested and hashrate-verified before dispatch. Payment is by major cryptocurrency; orders ship within 24–72 hours of cleared payment with full customs documentation.

## Shop

- [All products](https://bitcoinminingdepot.net/products): Full catalog of new, used and refurbished ASIC miners with live price and stock status.
- [ASIC miners](https://bitcoinminingdepot.net/collections/asic-miners): SHA-256 bitcoin mining hardware collection.
- [Used & refurbished miners](https://bitcoinminingdepot.net/collections/used-refurbished-asic-miners): Bench-tested secondary-market units.
- [Immersion cooling miners](https://bitcoinminingdepot.net/collections/immersion-cooling-miners): Immersion-cooled ASIC models.
- [Hosting solutions](https://bitcoinminingdepot.net/collections/hosting-solutions): Machines available with managed hosting.
- [Wholesale](https://bitcoinminingdepot.net/wholesale): Volume/pallet pricing for multi-unit orders.
- [Bitcoin mining marketplace](https://bitcoinminingdepot.net/bitcoin-mining-marketplace): Local buying, pricing and shipping guides by city and country.

## Services

- [Hosting](https://bitcoinminingdepot.net/hosting): Managed hosting for customer-owned miners.
- [Repair services](https://bitcoinminingdepot.net/repair-services): Hashboard, PSU and controller repair.
- [Warranty](https://bitcoinminingdepot.net/warranty): Warranty terms and DOA protection.
- [Shipping & returns](https://bitcoinminingdepot.net/shipping-returns): Freight lanes, customs and returns policy.
